description: This is an abstract Java class 'BaseHealthChecker' that provides a framework for performing health checks on monitoring services, including sending test payloads, waiting for WebSocket updates, and reporting latencies and failures.

classes.name: BaseHealthChecker
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for health checkers that perform test payload sending, WebSocket update verification, and latency reporting for monitoring services.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a health check by sending a test payload, waiting for WebSocket updates, and reporting the results. Also recursively checks associated health checkers.

methods.name: checkWsUpdates
methods.description: Verifies that WebSocket updates contain the expected test data and calculated fields if enabled.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the health checker info after construction.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Abstract method for initializing the health checker.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize the client connection.

methods.name: createTestPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to create a test payload with a given test value.

methods.name: sendTestPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to send the test payload.

methods.name: destroyClient
methods.description: Abstract method to clean up client resources.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve information about the health checker.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Abstract method to get the unique key for the health checker.

methods.name: isCfMonitoringEnabled
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if calculated field monitoring is enabled.
